items.claim: Joel Alvarez possesses good grappling capabilities to counter ground threats.
Dustin Stoltzfus enters the pocket with his hands down, leading to his defensive lapses.
items.quote: he'll often enter the pocket with his hands down, and just goodnight.

items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus has good kicks at range and pretty good output.
items.quote: He's got really good kicks at range anyway. Um he's got good kicks, and he's got pretty good output.

items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus has good takedowns and really good slams, having beaten Joe Pyfer.
items.quote: Decent takedowns. He's got really good slams, though. You can ask Joe Pyfer about that. That's the top five opponent that Dustin Stoltzfus has beaten.

items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus attacks submissions very well and has good sweeps.
items.quote: He does attack submissions very well. He does have good sweeps.

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik has a long jab, is patient on the feet, and possesses natural knockout power.
items.quote: he does have a long jab. He is patient on the feet, and he's definitely got the power to knock out a guy like Dustin Stoltzfus.

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik is open to counters and does not have great striking defense.
items.quote: Mansour is very much open to counters, as well. It's not like he has great striking defense

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik has good MMA grappling with strong takedown options, body locks, and the ability to catch kicks.
items.quote: as far as MMA grappling, I have to give that edge to Abdul Malik because he's got good takedown options, right? He can control where the fight takes place. He's got a good body lock. He's good at catching kicks

items.claim: Mansour Abdul-Malik has good takedown defense, allowing him to dictate where the fight takes place.
items.quote: He's also got good takedown defense, which is why I think he's the one that's dictating where this fight takes place.
